name: paracetamol
hindi: Bukhar / dard ke liye. Khane ke baad 1 goli, din me max 3.
bengali: Jor / byathar jonno. Khabar pore 1 ta, dine max 3.
marathi: Taap / dukhisathi. Jevnanantar 1 goli, divsat max 3.
notes: Warn if duplicate paracetamol brands together

name: azithromycin
hindi: Infection maarne ke liye. Roz 1 goli 3-5 din, course pura karo, beech me band mat karo.
bengali: Infection marar jonno. Roz 1 ta 3-5 din, course sesh koro.
marathi: Sansarg nasht karasathi. Roz 1 goli 3-5 divas, course purna kara.

name: amoxicillin
hindi: Gale/chhati infection ke liye. 5 din course pura.
bengali: Gola/buker infection er jonno. 5 din course.

name: metformin
hindi: Sugar control ke liye. Khane ke saath, meetha kam, roz walk.
bengali: Sugar niyontron er jonno. Khabar sathe.

name: glimepiride
hindi: Sugar ki dawai, subah khali pet nahi, nashte ke pehle.
bengali: Sugar er osudh, sokale jolkhabar age.

name: losartan
hindi: High BP ke liye. Roz subah 1, namak kam.
bengali: High BP er jonno. Roz sokale 1, lobon kom.
marathi: High BP sathi. Roz sakali 1, meeth kami.

name: atorvastatin
hindi: Cholesterol ke liye. Raat ko 1, tel kam.

name: cetirizine
hindi: Chheenk/ khujli ke liye. Raat ko 1, neend aa sakti hai.

name: omeprazole
hindi: Acidity ke liye. Subah khali pet 1.
bengali: Acidity er jonno. Sokale khali pete 1.

name: ors
hindi: Dast/ulti me paani ki kami ke liye. Ubla paani me ghol ke piyo.
